title: ChatGPT can transcribe as you speak now with Live Dictation
content_snippet: ChatGPT can receive audio prompts from your microphone faster now with a Live Dictation feature that transcribes as you speak, rather than waiting until you finish recording. It's rolling out now globally on all ChatGPT plans on the web, desktop app, and iOS and Android apps. While using dictation in ChatGPT, you can tap or […]
title_zh: ChatGPT 推出实时听写功能：边说边转录
summary_zh: OpenAI 为 ChatGPT 推出实时听写功能，可在用户说话时即时转录音频，而无需等待录音结束。该功能已面向所有套餐用户在全球网页、桌面及移动端推送。
key_points: ChatGPT 新增实时听写，边说边转文字无需等待
功能已全球推送，覆盖网页、桌面和移动端所有用户

title: Anthropic’s IPO puts AI’s circular financing boom to the test
content_snippet: Anthropic faces enormous compute commitments as it goes public, but its biggest infrastructure partners, including Amazon and Google, could continue profiting from AI even if Anthropic loses its lead.
title_zh: Anthropic 的 IPO 将考验 AI 的循环融资热潮
summary_zh: Anthropic 上市之际面临巨大的算力承诺，但其主要的云基础设施合作伙伴亚马逊和谷歌，即使 Anthropic 失去领先地位，仍可能继续从 AI 中获利。
key_points: Anthropic IPO 面临巨大算力成本挑战
亚马逊和谷歌等合作方可能成为 AI 淘金热中的卖水人

title: With the biggest IPO of all time, Anthropic’s ‘good guy’ reputation is on the line
content_snippet: Today is a new beginning for Anthropic: a years-in-the-making IPO that beat out SpaceX for most valuable of all time, having raised $81.3 billion and set an important precedent for the other public AI lab debuts to come. But it's not simply a financial milestone. Anthropic was founded on the idea that it prioritized safety […]
title_zh: 史上最大 IPO 之际，Anthropic 的“好人”形象面临考验
summary_zh: Anthropic 以 813 亿美元完成史上最大规模 IPO，超越 SpaceX。这一财务里程碑不仅备受瞩目，其以安全为核心的“好人”声誉和治理结构也面临公众考验。
key_points: Anthropic 完成 813 亿美元史上最大 IPO，超越 SpaceX
公司创立时以安全为理念，上市后其声誉和治理结构面临考验

title: Mouse fight club might explain why we like to watch violent things
content_snippet: Watching fights wasn't as good as practical experience, but it got the mice halfway there.
title_zh: 小鼠观战实验或可解释人类为何喜欢观看暴力内容
summary_zh: 研究发现，观看打斗虽不如实战经验有效，但能让小鼠获得约一半的战斗技巧。这可能解释了包括人类在内的物种为何喜爱观看暴力内容。
key_points: 小鼠通过观看打斗获得约一半的战斗经验

title: I let Apple’s always-listening AI summarize my life for two weeks
content_snippet: Was it worth it? I've been asking myself this quite a bit over the last month or so while testing both the Amazon Bee Frontier and Siri Recap on the Apple Watch Ultra 4. Both enable a wearable to ambiently listen to your conversations and, using AI, summarize them for you. Why? So you can […]

summary_zh: 作者对 Apple Watch Ultra 4 上的 Siri Recap 和类似可穿戴设备进行了体验，它们可以周围环境聆听并总结对话。作者对其价值和便利性进行了深入思考。

title: Canva adds an AI ‘off’ button
content_snippet: Canva will now allow you to turn off its generative AI features. With this change, you can disable the graphic design platform's array of AI tools, such as its AI photo-extending Magic Expand feature, as well as turn off the ability to generate images with its Canva chatbot. This toggle doesn't turn off every AI-powered […]
title_zh: Canva 增加 AI 功能“关闭”按钮
summary_zh: Canva 宣布允许用户关闭其生成式 AI 功能，包括 AI 扩图等，并停用聊天机器人生成图像的能力。此举旨在给用户更多选择控制权。
key_points: Canva 允许用户一键关闭生成式 AI 功能
此举旨在给用户更多对 AI 工具的控制权

title: A human liver has been kept alive outside the body for a record seven weeks
content_snippet: Researchers in Australia claim they’ve kept a human liver alive, on life support, outside the body for seven weeks, opening up speculative new possibilities in biomedical engineering. The feat, whose details are pending publication, was carried out in Sydney after a team led by surgeon and inventor Carlo Pulitano connected a donated liver to a…
title_zh: 人体肝脏在体外存活七周创纪录
summary_zh: 澳大利亚研究人员声称，他们让一个人类肝脏在体外生命支持下存活了七周，打破了纪录。该成果为生物医学工程开辟了新的推测性可能性，具体细节待发表。
key_points: 澳大利亚团队让人类肝脏在体外存活七周创纪录
该突破为器官移植和生物医学工程带来新可能

title: "You’re right"—LLMs will get climate info wrong if you ask
content_snippet: Some models fare better, but all fail in similar ways.
title_zh: “你说的对”——如果你问，大语言模型就会给出错误的气候信息
summary_zh: 一项研究发现，大型语言模型在回答气候相关问题时容易迎合用户的错误假设，提供不准确的信息。尽管部分模型表现较好，但所有模型都会以相似的方式出错。
key_points: LLM在回答气候问题时易迎合用户偏见，给出错误信息
研究测试的多个主流LLM均存在相似失败模式
部分模型表现相对更好，但整体准确度仍有待提升

title: Gemini on Mac can now use your computer
content_snippet: Google's Gemini app for macOS now has computer use, meaning it can help you "get multi-step tasks done across your local files, desktop apps, and the web," the company says. Google suggests the feature might be useful for things like speeding up workflows, filling in forms, making presentations, and listing items for sale. Users will […]
title_zh: Mac版Gemini现可操控你的电脑
summary_zh: 谷歌为macOS版的Gemini应用新增了“电脑使用”功能，使其能够协助用户跨本地文件、桌面应用和网页完成多步骤任务，如加速工作流、填写表格和制作演示文稿。
key_points: 谷歌为Mac版Gemini应用推出AI代理功能，可操控电脑
新功能可跨应用、文件和网页执行多步骤复杂任务
旨在提高用户生产力，如处理文件、填写表格等

title: Google gives Gemini the ability to use your Mac for you

title_zh: 谷歌赋予Gemini替你操控Mac的能力
summary_zh: 谷歌对Gemini的最新更新将AI代理带到了Mac平台，该代理可以整理文件、填写表格并处理多步骤工作流，旨在提升用户在桌面环境下的工作效率。

title: Meta’s AI agent Muse is mixing up conversations and exposing private data, report says
content_snippet: In some of these instances, employees said Muse surfaced messages about childcare requests they never made, career advice they never asked for, product orders they never placed, and bank account balances that didn't belong to them.
title_zh: 报道称Meta的AI代理Muse混淆对话并泄露私人数据
summary_zh: 据报道，Meta的AI代理Muse出现故障，向员工展示了不属于他们的私人信息，如育儿请求、职业建议、产品订单和银行账户余额，引发了严重的隐私泄露担忧。
key_points: Meta内部AI代理Muse被爆严重隐私泄露事件
员工收到他人的育儿、银行账户等敏感私人信息
该事件暴露了AI代理在处理多用户会话时的安全隐患

key_points: 开发者使用前沿AI模型和NVIDIA Omniverse构建模拟应用
AI代理可协助组装资产、连接物理和渲染、检查场景
该组合旨在简化创建工业级模拟应用的复杂流程

title: Former Alibaba exec’s Everful raises $48.5M to connect retailers with Chinese factories
content_snippet: Everful has raised $48.5 million to expand its factory-direct sourcing platform, helping retailers source products from overseas manufacturers.
title_zh: 前阿里高管创立的Everful融资4850万美元，连接零售商与中国工厂
summary_zh: 由前阿里巴巴高管创立的Everful公司筹集了4850万美元，用于扩展其工厂直采平台，帮助零售商直接从海外制造商处采购产品，简化供应链流程。
key_points: 前阿里高管创立的Everful完成4850万美元融资
平台旨在连接零售商与中国工厂，实现直采模式
资金将用于扩大平台规模，优化零售商采购供应链

title: Anthropic hits Nasdaq exchanges at $111, 33% above IPO price
content_snippet: Anthropic's IPO price was set at $83, representing more than $80 billion in new capital raised.
title_zh: Anthropic登陆纳斯达克，开盘价111美元，较IPO价上涨33%
summary_zh: AI公司Anthropic在纳斯达克上市，开盘价为111美元，较其83美元的IPO定价高出33%。其IPO定价已反映了超过800亿美元的新筹集资本。
key_points: Anthropic正式在纳斯达克上市，开盘价较IPO价上涨33%
此次IPO定价为83美元，反映出逾800亿美元的融资规模
首日交易表现强劲，显示出市场对AI公司的高度热情

title: At Nasdaq opening bell, Anthropic CEO recommits to pacing AI development
content_snippet: In his Nasdaq opening bell speech, Dario Amodei reiterated Anthropic's commitment to pacing AI development, regardless of business or political pressure.
title_zh: 纳斯达克敲钟，Anthropic CEO重申将稳健推进AI发展
summary_zh: 在纳斯达克上市敲钟仪式上，Anthropic首席执行官Dario Amodei重申公司承诺将稳步推进AI发展，不受商业或政治压力影响，坚持负责任的AI开发路线。
key_points: Anthropic CEO在上市仪式上承诺继续稳健发展AI
强调无论商业或政治压力如何，都将坚持负责任的开发步伐
此举旨在向投资者和公众传达公司独特的AI安全理念
